bullets.title: Exogenous Testosterone or Testosterone with Finasteride Increases Bone Mineral Density in Older Men with Low Serum Testosterone
bullets.note:
I’m not a doctor and don’t play one on the Internet, but this was sent to me by a well-respected researcher who focuses a lot on [mTOR](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MTOR) and other subjects. I take neither drug but found it worth the read. Here is an excerpt of the abstract:  
​**​  
​**“This finding suggests that dihydrotestosterone is not essential for the beneficial effects of T on BMD in men. In addition, the concomitant administration of F with T appears to attenuate the impact of T therapy on prostate size and PSA and might reduce the chance of benign prostatic hypertrophy or other prostate-related complications in older men on T therapy. These findings have important implications for the prevention and treatment of osteoporosis in older men with low T levels.”

bullets.title: The Gatekeepers
bullets.note: ([Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Gatekeepers-Yuval-Diskin/dp/B00DHNB3X0/), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mIJ82edWqWg), [Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/movie/the-gatekeepers/umc.cmc.1z9t0ip079olblpwrhi3kbi13?action=play)). Here is the official description: “Charged with overseeing Israel’s war on terror—both Palestinian and Jewish—the head of the [Shin Bet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shin_Bet), Israel’s secret service, is present at the crossroad of every decision made. For the first time ever, six former heads of the agency agreed to share their insights and reflect publicly on their actions and decisions. _The Gatekeepers_ offers an exclusive account of the sum of their successes and failures. It validates the reasons that each man individually and the six as a group came to reconsider their hard-line positions and advocate a conciliatory approach toward their enemies based on a two-state solution.” The documentary was nominated for Best Documentary Feature at the 85th Academy Awards and has a [94% score on Rotten Tomatoes](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/the_gatekeepers_2012), and _The New York Times_ [described it](https://www.nytimes.com/2012/12/16/movies/a-o-scotts-25-best-films-of-2012.html?pagewanted=all) as “essential, eye-opening viewing if you think you understand the Middle East.” You can [find the trailer here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HdMjr8cuEy8) and read [the reception section on Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Gatekeepers_(film)#Reception) to see the broader scope of the response to the film in Israel and elsewhere.
